hints: Look closely at the side chain on polymer X, the CO2CH3 group tells you the key functional group present.
Remember that a CO2CH3 side chain is a methyl ester, so think about what reagents hydrolyse esters.
Check if the polymer has any O-H or acidic H for sodium to react with, then combine 1 and 2 to pick your answer.
walkthrough:
**Identify the functional group in the side chain**

Look at each repeat unit. The backbone is just C-C single bonds, but each unit carries a $\text{CO}_2\text{CH}_3$ group.

That is $\text{-C(=O)OCH}_3$, which is a methyl ester group.

**Recall ester hydrolysis**

Esters are hydrolysed by heating with aqueous acid or aqueous alkali to give carboxylic acid or carboxylate salt plus alcohol.

$$\text{RCO}_2\text{CH}_3 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \xrightarrow{\text{H}^+} \text{RCO}_2\text{H} + \text{CH}_3\text{OH}$$
$$\text{RCO}_2\text{CH}_3 + \text{NaOH} \rightarrow \text{RCO}_2^-\text{Na}^+ + \text{CH}_3\text{OH}$$

**Test statements 1 and 2**

Aqueous sulfuric acid provides $\text{H}^+ (aq)$ for acid hydrolysis, so 1 reacts.

Aqueous sodium hydroxide provides $\text{OH}^- (aq)$ for alkaline hydrolysis, so 2 reacts.

**Test statement 3 with sodium**

Sodium metal reacts with groups containing acidic hydrogen, such as $\text{-OH}$ and $\text{-CO}_2\text{H}$.

Polymer X has only ester $\text{CO}_2\text{CH}_3$ groups and alkane C-H bonds, with no O-H bonds, so sodium does not react. Therefore 1 and 2 only is correct.

options.A: Incorrect because it includes all three reagents. While 1 and 2 correctly hydrolyse the ester side chains, 3 is wrong as there is no -OH or -CO2H group for sodium to react with.
options.B: Correct because only 1 and 2 react. Both aqueous sulfuric acid and aqueous sodium hydroxide hydrolyse the methyl ester side chains to carboxylic acid and carboxylate salt respectively, while sodium has no acidic proton to react with.
options.C: Incorrect because it includes sodium. Sodium needs a labile proton from an alcohol or carboxylic acid, which polymer X does not have, and it omits aqueous sulfuric acid which does hydrolyse esters.
options.D: Incorrect because it includes only 1. Aqueous sulfuric acid does hydrolyse the ester, but aqueous sodium hydroxide also hydrolyses it by base hydrolysis, so 2 should also be included.
